run_tabular_q_smoke_test: run the tabular Q-learning smoke test with 5 episode length and 10 episodes on the crc32 benchmark
test_tabular_q_main_with_flags: test the tabular Q main function by setting absl flags for episode length, episodes, log interval, and benchmark
test_capture_output_from_main: test that running tabular Q main captures stdout output containing the resulting sequence
test_tabular_q_with_custom_benchmark: test the tabular Q learning module by configuring a custom benchmark via the --benchmark flag
test_tabular_q_flag_configuration: test the tabular Q module by unparsing flags and reconfiguring episode length, episodes, and log interval
